dialogues.speaker: Yu Huangyi
dialogues.text: I do not believe there is anything particularly exceptional about my time.

dialogues.speaker: Yu Huangyi
dialogues.text: At that time, everyone situated themselves around Mt. Tianheng. Those who had the strength engaged in blacksmithing, while the others agile of body would venture into the hills to hunt and forage.

dialogues.speaker: Yu Huangyi
dialogues.text: Morax — heh, he was neither Rex Lapis nor the Geo Lord then — called himself Mr. Mo.

dialogues.speaker: Yu Huangyi
dialogues.text: "The divine artifact remains, and chaos has been kept at bay. The world is at peace. Dwell I shall for now in this corner of the mortal world."

dialogues.speaker: Yu Huangyi
dialogues.text: I have been apprised of what happened after — the world became topsy-turvy, and Mr. Mo's "corner of the world" subsequently became much bigger.
